source_book: Modern GPU Programming For MLSys (MLC Community) + NVIDIA Blackwell Tuning/Compatibility Guides

test_cases.prompt: Decompose a QK^T + mask + softmax + PV operator into Blackwell scope/layout/dispatch.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and output the scope, layout, dispatch, and handoff for each stage.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Should this TIRx primitive be invoked by a single lane, a warp, or a warpgroup?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and distinguish the issue scope from the participation scope.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Review the GMEM/SMEM/TMEM/register lifetimes of this B200 kernel for me.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and produce the lifetimes and the contract table.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Help me choose the number of Transformer layers.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not trigger; this is model architecture.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: How much does a DGX B200 weigh?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not trigger; this is a system spec.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: I only want to use cuBLASLt, but I don't know how to fill in the layout.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The layout portion may be invoked; no need to expand into custom scheduling — focus on the library interface contract.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge_case must state the invocation boundary. These tests are prompt/behavior stress tests, not hardware performance tests.
